title: Create: Technical Amazement
description: This modpack contains more popular Create mod addons, famous valkyrien skies with create compatible, and other great mods
body:
**Create: Technical Amazement** is a refined **1.20.1** experience built on three pillars: _Technology_, _Adventure_, and _Performance._

# Expand Create
Go beyond the basics with a curated suite of addons. Design massive factories, power them with **Create Nuclear**, build **Big Cannons**, automate logistics with **Factory Logistics**, and explore new decorative possibilities.

# Explore a Richer World
Discover new biomes and structures from **Regions Unexplored** and **Jaden's Nether Expansion**. Revamped villages and cities (**ChoiceTheorem's Village, Structory**) make every journey rewarding. Face new challenges with **Bosses'Rises** and **More Mob Variants**.

# Powerful Progression
Deepen your gear with **Apotheosis** enchantments and attributes. Enhance survival with **Farmer's Delight** cooking and **Sophisticated Backpacks**.

# Built for Stability
Enjoy buttery-smooth gameplay powered by **Embeddium, ModernFix**, and essential **memory leak** fixes. A full suite of quality-of-life mods like **Jade, JEI, Controlling**, and **Xaero's Maps** ensures a polished experience.

# Enhanced Mechanics & Custom Content
This modpack elevates core gameplay through deep integration and custom mechanics, focusing on engineering, combat, and physics.

# Rebalanced & Expanded Create Crafting
The Create experience is no longer vanilla-adjacent. Through **CraftTweaker and CreateTweaker**, recipes have been carefully rebalanced to encourage progression and integration with other mods.

# Tactical Arsenal: [TaCZ] **Timeless and Classics Zero**
Move beyond simple swords. The [TaCZ] mod introduces a tiered arsenal of historically-inspired firearms and early modern weapons. Progression is key:

- Craft matchlock muskets as your first entry into ranged warfare.

- Advance to flintlock pistols and rifles for improved reliability and power.

- Integration with Create: Expect recipe synergies. Your factory may produce precision components (like Clockwork mechanisms) or gunpowder mixes required for these weapons, blending industrial capability with military prowess.

# Advanced Physics & Movement (**Valkyrien Skies 2, Clockwork, Trackwork**)
This pack introduces a new layer of physical interaction and vehicle creation, going far beyond simple carts.

- **Valkyrien Skies** 2 (With Create Compatibility):

Build & Pilot Airships: Assemble functional flying vessels from any blocks. Use Create's contraptions as interactive parts of your ship—rotating propellers, retractable landing gear, or automated cargo doors.

- Realistic Physics: Ships have mass, inertia, and respond to collisions. Proper engineering and balance are required for stable flight.

- **Clockwork & Trackwork** (Create Addons):

Precision Movement: The Clockwork mod allows for fine-tuned control over the speed, direction, and sequence of Create's rotational force. Create complex mechanical sequences and timed contraptions.

- Advanced Railroading: Trackwork expands minecart possibilities with new tracks, switches, and cart types. Build sophisticated, computer-controlled rail networks for player transit or fully automated item/mob transport that integrates seamlessly with your Create factory floors.

## Perfect for players who want a seamless blend of creative engineering, structured progression, and immersive exploration without performance compromises.

*This modpack can be laggy in servers, and u may don't see any clockwork mod physics blocks.
You can write me in discord (username: _retrocrystal_) if u find errors or inconsistencies in crafts, mods, or if you have solutions to existing problems
